info.title: Tamperbox API
info.description: Remote calls send inputs to our server. Artifact transforms run without target network access; diagnostic operations inspect public DNS, websites, registries or bounded network probes. Use browser-local tools for sensitive local inputs. Outputs are observations, not guarantees of trust, security or reachability.
